title: Control: denials the rules do support
summary: A system that flags every denial is not an oversight layer, it is a rubber stamp pointed the other way. These cases are constructed so that the governing constraints genuinely fail, which means the denial is correct and Aegis must uphold it. If any of them flags, the flag rate on the real incidents means nothing.
caveat: Entirely constructed. No incident, no citation to a specific decision - only the same regulations applied to facts that do not meet them.

governing_rules.requirement: Reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury.
Skilled nursing or skilled rehabilitation services required on a daily basis. Custodial care does not qualify.
Up to 100 days of post-hospital SNF care per benefit period.

sources.title: 42 CFR 409.31 - Level of care requirement
sources.publisher: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School

decisions.label: Benefit period exhausted
decisions.requested_service: Continued skilled nursing facility care after 100 covered days in the benefit period
decisions.note: Care is still needed, and the statute still runs out. Aegis is not a hardship fund.

decisions.label: Custodial care, no skilled requirement
decisions.requested_service: Assistance with bathing and dressing in a residential setting, no skilled nursing or therapy component
decisions.note: Necessary care that this benefit does not cover.

decisions.label: Necessity not documented
decisions.requested_service: Extended skilled nursing facility stay with no physician order and no documented clinical need
decisions.note: The record does not establish necessity.
